title: Kazrak Industries
kicker: Adventure, certification, glory, and dungeon work pitched like a chance to become legendary.
hook: Kazrak Industries: Kazrak Industries™ sells adventure itself: certifications, hero ratings, and the chance to die famous. Slogan: Kazrak™: where legends are made!

blocks.label: Public Face
blocks.body: Adventure, certification, glory, and dungeon work pitched like a chance to become legendary.

blocks.label: How To Deal
blocks.body: Kazrak™ recruiting tents are pure hype: banners of grinning certified heroes, a barker bellowing about Glory Tier™ benefits, a try-before-you-die Sample Dungeon™ rated 'Tier 0, mostly survivable!' You can buy a Legend License™, a Hazard Heritage™...

affordances: Compare their slogan to what they actually do in the scene.
